_what_this_is: The DECLARATIVE input to ALGORITHM A10 (chain_lineage.py). It declares, for one SAP installation, (a) the identifier GRAMMARS whose string structure carries meaning the schema does not, and (b) the HOPS of the address chain that links funding to work. A10 measures it; this file asserts nothing. Another installation ships its own spec and the algorithm is unchanged — that is the portability contract.
_why_it_is_a_spec_and_not_code: The finding that produced A10 is that UNESCO's model dimensions live in the IDENTIFIER STRING, not in foreign keys. Which positions of which string carry which meaning is INSTALLATION-SPECIFIC. Hard-coding it would make the algorithm a UNESCO script; declaring it makes it a product.

grammars.why: the fund code is the root identifier of the whole chain — project id and WBS root are both copies of it
the only live organisational dimension in the FM ledger; its code is a 3-letter org acronym
POSID = <fund code>.<level2>.<level3>... — the 4-level spine is encoded as dot depth, not as a parent key
PSPID is expected to BE the fund code — project-as-fund, a string identity rather than a foreign key

dimension_carriers.why: MEASURE (Funded Program) is SAP's designed WBS-to-FM bridge. Measuring its population decides whether the designed chain exists at all.

hops.semantic: which funding source pays for this piece of work
hops.designed_carrier: FMMEASURE / Funded Program derivation via FMDERIVE
hops.expect: SUBSTITUTED — the designed carrier is unused and the grammar carries it instead

hops.semantic: the PS project scaffold and the fund it mirrors
hops.designed_carrier: none — Fund and Project are meant to be independent dimensions
hops.expect: SUBSTITUTED — an inversion the 2017 design explicitly forbade, still load-bearing

hops.semantic: the WBS element and its project definition
hops.designed_carrier: PRPS.PSPHI -> PROJ.PSPNR (the real SAP foreign key)
hops.actual_carrier: same, plus the string root agrees

hops.semantic: which C/5 programmatic output this fund serves
hops.expect: UNEVEN — a custom carrier is expected to serve some fund families and not others, with no declared rule for which

hops.semantic: the planning/sector line the fund belongs to
hops.expect: UNEVEN — a custom carrier is expected to serve some fund families and not others, with no declared rule for which

hops.semantic: the FM actual line and its funding source
the FM actual line and the piece of work it funded
hops.expect: BROKEN — this is the hop the whole model needs and does not have

hops.semantic: the FM actual line and the availability bucket it consumes
hops.designed_carrier: Fund x Fund Center x commitment item
hops.actual_carrier: same, but the commitment-item leg is collapsed to a grouped bucket
hops.expect: COLLAPSED — many cost categories share one availability pool
hops.scope_reason: the FM line carries a real commitment item; the availability bucket it consumes carries a grouped one. The ratio of the two is the measurement of how much cost-category resolution the control layer destroys — "el AVC es compartido", quantified

instruments._why: A hop is only as trustworthy as the instruments that can see it. For each right-hand object we ask: can we observe WHO changed it (change log) and WHICH channel wrote it (execution log)? A hop nobody can observe is a hop nobody can govern.

change_log._why_two: an installation may keep a filtered current log and a fuller history. A class present only in the second is invisible to anyone querying the first, so both are measured and the difference between them is itself reported.

execution_log.note: A8 attributes a change stream to the programs that ran in the same user-hour. Where the change log is BLIND, A8 is the only instrument left.

_verdicts.LIVE: resolves through the carrier designed to carry it
_verdicts.SUBSTITUTED: resolves through a string convention or custom table instead of the designed carrier — works, and invisible in the data model
_verdicts.COLLAPSED: resolves, but many finer addresses share one coarser one: control survives, attribution does not
_verdicts.UNEVEN: coverage differs wildly across identifier families with no declared rule for who gets a link
_verdicts.PARTIAL: the carrier covers only part of the population
_verdicts.BROKEN: does not resolve, or the carrier is declared and never populated

consistency_checks.fact: the hierarchy level of a WBS element

carrier_a._is: the IDENTIFIER — level claimed by counting separators in the code

carrier_b._is: the STRUCTURE — level walked up the real parent-child tree

consistency_checks.why: the whole chain rests on the identifier convention. This is the only place we can ask whether the convention agrees with the structure it stands in for, because here and only here both carriers exist

hierarchies.what: FUND CENTRES — the organisational / responsibility axis
hierarchies._measured_not_assumed: the class was chosen by matching set LEAF VALUES against the master: class 0312 matches fund_centers at 100%, class 0102 at 0% — 0102 holds GL account groups keyed by chart of accounts. Picking a set class by SAP convention rather than by measurement is how the wrong hierarchy gets traversed confidently.

hierarchies.what: GL ACCOUNT groups, by chart of accounts
NOT a fund-centre hierarchy — cost-centre style groups
hierarchies._corrected: declared as 'numeric fund centres' on a 79.3% leaf match against the fund-centre master. That match was NUMERIC COLLISION: codes like '100' exist in both masters. Traversed, only 9 of 505 reached values are real fund centres and the node names are CS01-4000 / COI-6-0200. Matching values is not identifying a hierarchy.

derivation_mechanisms._what_this_is: HOW account assignments are derived in this installation. A hop can be BROKEN for two very different reasons — the rule was switched off, or the architecture has no way to produce that value at all — and only this section tells them apart. It is declared per installation and MEASURED, so the reason a carrier is empty is part of the model rather than a sentence someone wrote once.

mechanisms._why_it_cannot: the classic account-assignment derivation predates BCS. Funded Program and Grant are BCS-only dimensions and are outside what it produces.

mechanisms._evidence: strategy tables return zero rows with and without a TAB='FMDERIVE' filter, and FMDERIVE is not among the four registered derivation points in T811X

consequences.reason: the mechanism in use (CLASSIC_FM_DERIVATION) cannot produce it, and the mechanism that can (DERIVATION_TOOL_FMDERIVE) was never configured. So the empty column is architectural, not neglect — and adopting Funded Program means standing up a second derivation mechanism and migrating onto it, not configuring a field.
consequences.and_explains: why the identifier convention exists at all: the grammar is not a shortcut around a working feature, it is the only carrier available under this architecture
the 7-dimensional BCS design runs as 3 dimensions

consequences.reason: same mechanism gap; and no gm* tables exist
